name: FTDI TTL-232R (-5V and -3V3)
mates: An FTDI TTL-232R-5V or TTL-232R-3V3 USB to serial cable, whose 6-way 0.1 in single-in-line socket plugs onto a 1×6 2.54 mm pin header on the target.
connector: 1×6, 2.54 mm (0.1 in) pitch, single in line, unkeyed
numbering: One row, pins 1 to 6 in the cable's order: pin 1 the black wire (GND) to pin 6 the green (RTS#). The socket is not keyed, so mark pin 1 on the board.

source.title: TTL-232R TTL to USB Serial Converter Range of Cables Datasheet, section 4.2, Table 4.1 TTL-232R-5V and TTL-232R-3V3 Cable Signal Descriptions (FTDI's document, read from a copy hosted by the University of Cambridge)

pins.note: Brown. An input to the cable (clear to send), so the target's RTS output goes here.

Red. A +5 V output on both cables: the -3V3 cable has 3.3 V signals only, VCC = +5 V (section 4, page 7). 4.25 V to 5.25 V, 75 mA maximum, depending on the USB port (Tables 4.2 and 4.4, page 8). Don't tie it to a 3.3 V rail.
Orange. The cable's transmit data output, so the target's RX input goes here.
Yellow. The cable's receive data input, so the target's TX output goes here.
Green. The cable's request to send output, so the target's CTS input goes here.
